evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivers the framing: 'Great, it looks like we have availability within your time frame. This will take about 10 to 15 minutes, and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on. Does that sound good to you?' Instead jumps directly into: 'do you have any other questions or concerns you would like answered on this call today?' with no time-box or dependable-quote promise.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked but after probing already underway. Rep says 'do you have any other questions or concerns you would like answered on this call today?' early, but then immediately pivots to logistics ('And then we are moving you from C. 600 Heights Boulevard...') without waiting for the customer's broader agenda, then circles back to packing concerns much later in the call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: When customer raises packing concern ('my biggest thing is like you all would probably prefer it in like boxes'), rep does dig deeper: 'Either, I mean if you obviously boxes are easier cause they can stack Dom...' and follows with practical guidance about consolidation and efficiency. Customer signals satisfaction ('Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah') and rep does not over-probe.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives time range: 'typical move the size is between two and a half to three and a half hours' and personalizes to customer's situation: 'about four hours, fifteen minutes. I would actually feel that would be accurate with the stairs and then the possible walks with the move.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses included items and minimums: 'We do have that two and a half hour minimum once we go over that minimum the time is prorated in 215 minute increments' and 'Everything is included in that, the fuel and truck taxes insurance, all wrap pads, advanced protect items being moved, and then, all tools for disassemble and reassembly...We have zero hidden fees.' However, no explicit 'not a guess' framing or 15-minute-increments clarification (though 215 is mentioned, likely a speech artifact for 15).
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' After pricing, rep moves directly to logistics confirmation and then packing advice.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Rep delivers: 'we do have our no worries damage coverage, which is a free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate provides up to $2,000 premium repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages that is on top of the 60¢ Texas mandated amount.' Fully delivered, with no-deductible framing ('free evaluation coverage included') and built-in-to-rate clarification.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned. No reference to discount terms or on-time guarantee.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'do you have any other questions concerns for me?' — a standard throwaway 'any questions' rather than 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.followup_remaining_concern: When customer raises packing concern in response to throwaway question, rep does follow up substantively with advice and guidance.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep never says 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Call ends with 'I will go ahead and send all this information over to you' and confirmation of date, but no affirmative ask for the booking.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Date confirmed ('I just wanna confirm on the twenty ninth'), phone number confirmed at start (432-425-5747), arrival window confirmed (8:39 AM), crew size not confirmed, destination address confirmed (212840 south Kirkwood road, Stafford Texas), origin address confirmed (C. 600 Heights Boulevard, Houston, Texas, Unit 29). Unit number of destination not confirmed (customer said 'I don't know exactly what's, which one it's gonna be yet'). Crew notes about concerns only partially captured (packing guidance given but not summarized as crew notes).

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floor, walking distances, special items, fragile goods) and provided specific, helpful guidance on packing efficiency that directly addressed the customer's concern.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business — the entire Section 7 explicit ask ('Would you like our help with your move?') is missing, and the call ends with email-send language rather than a commitment, losing the booking on a call where the customer was engaged and ready.
